purpose: A response body carries the marker DPK-DAST-764 reports: Tornado HTTP error with its traceback.

groundTruth.rationale: The authored observation contains the body marker DPK-DAST-764 names, so a consumer of this pack must report it.

observation.body:
<!doctype html>
<html><body>
<section id="acme-report">
tornado.web.HTTPError?most recent call last
</section>
</body></html>

limitations: Synthetic response observation authored for this case; it is not a captured real response.
The case exercises one declared check; it does not establish how often that marker appears in real applications.

provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence
